data_description.url: The URL of your Navidrome server (e.g., https://navidrome.example.com)
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable if using a self-signed certificate

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Navidrome
reauth_confirm.description: Your credentials for {title} are no longer valid. Please enter your new password.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Navidrome server. Please check the URL.

abort.already_configured: This Navidrome server is already configured.

data_description.target_player: The media player that will play audio from Navidrome (e.g., a Sonos speaker, Chromecast, or browser player)
data_description.scrobble_enabled: Send 'now playing' status to Navidrome when music plays. Enables Discord status, Last.fm, and other scrobble-based plugins.
data_description.search_result_limit: Maximum songs, albums and artists fetched per search. Cards trim how many they display. Default: 500.
data_description.playlist_cache_ttl: How long the playlist list used for playlist search is cached, in seconds. 0 disables caching. Default: 30.
data_description.control_grace_seconds: After play, pause, stop or repeat changes, ignore contradicting updates from the target player for this many seconds so stale events don't flip the controls back. Default: 10.
